title: GitHub Copilot | Adoption & Usage
description: Daily enterprise Copilot adoption, engagement, client traffic, and customization aggregates.

options.content:
**Daily UTC trends.** All panels follow the global time picker; default: **90 days**. Auto-refresh is off to limit Athena scans. Use the dashboard links above to switch sections while preserving the time range.

**No data is not zero usage.** Only recorded dates are shown; lines may connect sparse observations. Missing source values are not replaced with zero.

Copilot reports can lag. Active-user counts are source-reported per enterprise, not distinct people across enterprises or days. Surfaces and customization categories overlap: do not add them together. Requests are model calls, not prompts. These are activity measures, not productivity scores or evidence of causation. No individual user or customization names are displayed.

panels.title: Active Copilot users | daily, weekly & monthly
panels.description: Source-reported rolling active-user counts on each report day, summed across stored enterprises. Weekly/monthly windows overlap; do not sum across days or treat these as cross-enterprise distinct people.

targets.rawSQL:
SELECT cast(report_day AS timestamp) AS time,
  sum(daily_active_users) AS daily_active,
  sum(weekly_active_users) AS weekly_active,
  sum(monthly_active_users) AS monthly_active
FROM github_copilot_silver_dev.enterprise_usage_daily
WHERE $__dateFilter(report_day)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1 ASC

panels.title: Copilot interactions, generations & acceptances
panels.description: Distinct source measures, not additive categories. Interactions are user initiated; generation/acceptance counts are telemetry activity, not requests, commits, or productivity.

targets.rawSQL:
SELECT cast(report_day AS timestamp) AS time,
  sum(user_initiated_interaction_count) AS interactions,
  sum(code_generation_activity_count) AS generations,
  sum(code_acceptance_activity_count) AS acceptances
FROM github_copilot_silver_dev.enterprise_usage_daily
WHERE $__dateFilter(report_day)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1 ASC

panels.title: Code acceptance / generation activity
panels.description: 100 * daily acceptance activity / generation activity, weighted by counts across enterprises. Not a suggestion-level acceptance probability. Null when the denominator is zero or absent; not capped at 100%.

targets.rawSQL:
SELECT cast(report_day AS timestamp) AS time,
  100.0 * sum(code_acceptance_activity_count)
    / nullif(sum(code_generation_activity_count), 0) AS acceptance_activity_ratio
FROM github_copilot_silver_dev.enterprise_usage_daily
WHERE $__dateFilter(report_day)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1 ASC

panels.title: Copilot-reported lines added & deleted
panels.description: Source-reported code-acceptance line counters, not repository diff statistics or a measure of code quality.

targets.rawSQL:
SELECT cast(report_day AS timestamp) AS time,
  sum(loc_added_sum) AS lines_added,
  sum(loc_deleted_sum) AS lines_deleted
FROM github_copilot_silver_dev.enterprise_usage_daily
WHERE $__dateFilter(report_day)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1 ASC

panels.title: Daily active users by Copilot surface
panels.description: CLI, App, cloud agent, and code review populations can overlap. Missing source counters remain null rather than zero.

targets.rawSQL:
SELECT cast(report_day AS timestamp) AS time,
  sum(daily_active_cli_users) AS cli,
  sum(daily_active_copilot_app_users) AS copilot_app,
  sum(daily_active_copilot_cloud_agent_users) AS cloud_agent,
  sum(daily_active_copilot_code_review_users) AS code_review
FROM github_copilot_silver_dev.enterprise_usage_daily
WHERE $__dateFilter(report_day)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1 ASC

panels.title: Model requests by client
panels.description: Successful model calls, not prompts or user interactions. One prompt may produce multiple requests. Client names are best-effort identifiers. Missing/empty breakdowns return no series.

targets.rawSQL:
SELECT cast(report_day AS timestamp) AS time,
  json_extract_scalar(client, '$.client') AS client,
  sum(cast(json_extract_scalar(client, '$.request_count') AS bigint)) AS requests
FROM github_copilot_silver_dev.enterprise_usage_daily
CROSS JOIN UNNEST(cast(json_parse(totals_by_client_json) AS array(json))) AS clients(client)
WHERE $__dateFilter(report_day)
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1 ASC, 2

panels.title: Client model traffic | prompt & output tokens
panels.description: Summed only across the server-counted client breakdown. Do not add these to overlapping IDE/CLI/App counters. Null token fields are not replaced with zeros.

targets.rawSQL:
SELECT cast(report_day AS timestamp) AS time,
  sum(cast(json_extract_scalar(client, '$.token_usage.prompt_tokens_sum') AS bigint)) AS prompt_tokens,
  sum(cast(json_extract_scalar(client, '$.token_usage.output_tokens_sum') AS bigint)) AS output_tokens
FROM github_copilot_silver_dev.enterprise_usage_daily
CROSS JOIN UNNEST(cast(json_parse(totals_by_client_json) AS array(json))) AS clients(client)
WHERE $__dateFilter(report_day)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1 ASC

panels.title: Customization interactions by category
panels.description: Enterprise aggregates only; customization names are not displayed. Each array is unnested independently to avoid multiplying counts. Categories overlap and must not be added together. Includes the source's other bucket.

targets.rawSQL:
WITH daily AS (
  SELECT report_day, totals_by_skill_json, totals_by_custom_agent_json,
    totals_by_mcp_json, totals_by_slash_cmd_json, totals_by_plugin_json
  FROM github_copilot_silver_dev.enterprise_usage_daily
  WHERE $__dateFilter(report_day)
), categories AS (
  SELECT report_day, 'Skills' AS category, item FROM daily
    CROSS JOIN UNNEST(cast(json_parse(totals_by_skill_json) AS array(json))) AS entries(item)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT report_day, 'Custom agents', item FROM daily
    CROSS JOIN UNNEST(cast(json_parse(totals_by_custom_agent_json) AS array(json))) AS entries(item)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT report_day, 'MCP servers', item FROM daily
    CROSS JOIN UNNEST(cast(json_parse(totals_by_mcp_json) AS array(json))) AS entries(item)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT report_day, 'Slash commands', item FROM daily
    CROSS JOIN UNNEST(cast(json_parse(totals_by_slash_cmd_json) AS array(json))) AS entries(item)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT report_day, 'Plugins', item FROM daily
    CROSS JOIN UNNEST(cast(json_parse(totals_by_plugin_json) AS array(json))) AS entries(item)
)
SELECT cast(report_day AS timestamp) AS time, category,
  sum(cast(json_extract_scalar(item, '$.interaction_count') AS bigint)) AS interactions
FROM categories
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1 ASC, 2

panels.title: Copilot-reported PR creation & review activity
panels.description: Enterprise Copilot report counters, not webhook counts. Copilot-created/reviewed counts are subsets of the respective totals, not additional PRs. Creation and review populations can overlap. Does not establish Copilot's causal effect.

targets.rawSQL:
SELECT cast(report_day AS timestamp) AS time,
  sum(pull_requests_created) AS created_total,
  sum(pull_requests_created_by_copilot) AS created_by_copilot,
  sum(pull_requests_reviewed) AS reviewed_total,
  sum(pull_requests_reviewed_by_copilot) AS reviewed_by_copilot
FROM github_copilot_silver_dev.enterprise_usage_daily
WHERE $__dateFilter(report_day)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1 ASC

panels.title: Interactions per daily active Copilot user
panels.description: Daily total user-initiated interactions divided by daily active users across enterprise report rows. Not a per-person ranking, unique-user measure across enterprises, or productivity score. Null when daily active users is zero or absent.

targets.rawSQL:
SELECT cast(report_day AS timestamp) AS time,
  cast(sum(user_initiated_interaction_count) AS double)
    / nullif(sum(daily_active_users), 0) AS interactions_per_active_user
FROM github_copilot_silver_dev.enterprise_usage_daily
WHERE $__dateFilter(report_day)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1 ASC
